answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 2198 Country: India Title: My father , mother & myself ALHAMDULILLAH done our hajj but after seven days coming from hajj my father died (inteqhal). after 3 months on friday before asar salah the same day our weekly gust(ijtema) were there i saw my father in dream and he telling that today is friday come on getup and go today is your gust (ijtema). please explain me. Question: My father , mother & myself ALHAMDULILLAH done our hajj but after seven days coming from hajj my father died (inteqhal). after 3 months on friday before asar salah the same day our weekly gust(ijtema) were there i saw my father in dream and he telling that today is friday come on getup and go today is your gust (ijtema). please explain me. Answer ID: 2198 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1940/1482=H) Ma-sha-Allah, it is a fortunate dream. It means that your father is getting benefit of your good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
